_comment: Engine hubs. One page per engine is generated to workshops/engine-<id>.html from this config joined with content/workshops.json. Every workshop id appears in exactly one section, so nothing is repeated on the page. Sections are ordered top to bottom; install=true marks a section that needs the free desktop app, install=false marks one that runs in the browser with nothing to install. titles, links, difficulty and age always come from the workshop data. Add an engine block and run: node scripts/generate-engine-hubs.js

engines.lumo: New here? Start with Start Here to pick an engine. The rest are one-off builds and blueprints you can dip into.
engines.pip: Try any of these in the browser first. Pick what looks fun and have a go.
engines.install: Many of these run in the browser. Some use a desktop engine, and the workshop page tells you what you need.
